phase_name: Redeploy, Full Gate Verification, and Record the Sweep

run deploy-headless.sh in foreground bounded timeout
confirm deployed report-format.md/summary-format.md/general-research-agent.md carry the new content

deviations.description: Run the complete gate set in the foreground (bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh, no flags)
deviations.reason: Dispatch file (.dispatch/22.md) carries a Batch Gate Deferral directive for this batch invocation: discharge this phase against a scoped tier (verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 3,4) instead of independently running the complete gate set, which runs once for the whole batch at the end of the /orchestrate invocation. deploy-headless.sh's own built-in fast-gate verification (--skip-slow, 41 checks) still ran as a side effect of the deploy and found only 2 pre-existing, out-of-scope failures (gate10 timeout flake, dead-command-recommendation lint) already named by the batch lead.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- Batch Gate Deferral directive from the dispatch file substitutes a scoped tier for the independent full battery)*
